Product Details: Having a low tyre pressure would increase the wear and tear of your tyres. We have a solution! Designed not only to measure tyre pressures, Groz Analog Tyre Inflator Gauge inflates and deflates tyres of cars and other light vehicles as and when required. To activate the tyre deflation is via the deflation valve on the gun body. A simple press of the valve will activate it and reduce pressure. For accuracy, we have ascertained that it is +/-2.5% accurate with the resolution of 2 PSI across the maximum pressure up to 60 PSI. It measures in 2 units, i.e., PSI & BAR. Note: An air pump/compressor is required to inflate tires.
